## Foods & dishes
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 4 dishes (1 Niger-only: dambou).
- [[World Wide Dishes]]: 3 Hausa/Fulani dishes shared with Nigeria (bean dumpling, Hausa rice pancake, millet dough ball).

## Ingredients & food composition
- No national FCT is in the vault. The [[FAO INFOODS global databases]] candidate (priority 2, directory of 308 tables) includes the FAO/INFOODS **West African Food Composition Table (WAFCT)**, a regional table for the ECOWAS countries including Niger; processing it is the most direct way to get local foods (fonio, cowpea, shea, baobab, leafy sauces). Until then, use [[USDA FoodData Central]] by name matching.
- [[CMAUP]]: 47 plants.

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 1 ethnobotany records (1 taxa).
- [[KNApSAcK Family]] lists Niger on its World map, but African flag pages were not scraped (counts unknown).
- Compound → effect chains come from the global backbone via [[Global]] ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[Phenol-Explorer]], [[SpiceRx]], [[DDID]] for food–drug interactions).
